answer: Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. Because the sable expiry is policed at the oasis gate, the harbor audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 554 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. That is 29 dollars per alias.
